description: A painted interior of a hall with red-and-white striped horseshoe arches and stone columns, lit by hanging lanterns and torches. A bearded man in a black robe with gold trim and a turban stands on a raised dais with one arm outstretched, a soft glow behind his head. Facing him, a man in a patterned tunic holds up a scroll. A crowd of turbaned men in robes stands around, some bowing, with a red chair on the dais and a patterned rug on the steps. No visible text, no frame, no blood.
